definitions.explanation: The physical spot or coordinates where something is situated. Also used for abstract positions such as rank or standing.

examples.japanese: {現在|げんざい}の{位置|いち}を{確認|かくにん}した。
この{建物|たてもの}は{駅|えき}から{便利|べんり}な{位置|いち}にある。
examples.english: This building is in a convenient location from the station.

examples.japanese: GPS で{自分|じぶん}の{位置|いち}{情報|じょうほう}を{送信|そうしん}することができる。
examples.english: You can transmit your location information using GPS.

notes:
A versatile word used for both physical location and figurative position. When used as a suru verb ({位置|いち}する), it means "to be located at" or "to be situated."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{位置|いち}{情報|じょうほう} (location information)
・{位置|いち}づけ (positioning, status)
・{位置|いち}を{確認|かくにん}する (confirm the position)
・{位置|いち}を{特定|とくてい}する (pinpoint the location)
・〜に{位置|いち}する (to be located at ~)
